items.title: Phase 0: add the manifest extract script and freeze the manifest against current source
items.context: Add scripts/extract-cli-engine-english-manifest.mjs (per the plan's required command shape) that scans packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts and emits the line-level manifest (columns: translationId, sourceLine, surface, chineseSource, proposedEnglish, reviewStatus). Regenerate against the CURRENT source (767 Chinese lines), re-anchor sourceLine, add the 5 rows missing since the 762-row snapshot, carry over the approved English from the plan doc, and keep M668/M669/M750 marked behavior-sensitive (out of scope here). Implementation may not start until every Chinese line maps to an approved row. relatedDocs: docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md.

happy.desc: scripts/extract-cli-engine-english-manifest.mjs exists and is executable via node -> exits 0 and produces non-empty output to stdout; WHY: confirms the script was created and runs without error

Run node scripts/extract-cli-engine-english-manifest.mjs > /tmp/manifest.md; grep -c translationId /tmp/manifest.md -> at least 1 header row with the 6 required columns (translationId, sourceLine, surface, chineseSource, proposedEnglish, reviewStatus); WHY: manifest schema matches the plan spec
Count manifest data rows (excluding header) -> exactly 767 rows, matching grep -cP CJK cli-engine.ts; WHY: every Chinese-bearing line has a manifest entry, no omissions
grep -P behavior-sensitive /tmp/manifest.md lists exactly M668, M669, M750 -> no other rows carry that status; WHY: re-scan for runtime Chinese matchers found nothing beyond the known 3

Diff the manifest proposedEnglish column against the plan doc T-table approved English for overlapping IDs -> approved English is carried over unchanged; WHY: ensures plan-doc approved translations are preserved

edge.desc: Run the extract script twice in succession -> output is byte-identical (deterministic); WHY: manifest generation must be reproducible for CI freezing

Verify the 5 drifted/new rows (767 minus original 762) are present in the manifest with correct sourceLine anchoring -> sourceLine values match actual grep -n positions in current cli-engine.ts; WHY: re-anchoring after B-4e06 drift is correct

Manifest rows whose reviewStatus is not approved or behavior-sensitive -> zero rows with review-draft or needs-rewrite remain; WHY: gate condition requires all rows approved or deferred before Phase 1 starts
No source string in cli-engine.ts is edited in this phase -> git diff packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts shows zero changes after CHK-001; WHY: Phase 0 is manifest-only, no source edits

adversarial.desc: Inject a new Chinese comment into cli-engine.ts (line 1: // 测试), re-run extract script -> manifest row count increases to 768 and the new line appears with a translationId; revert the injection; WHY: script must detect arbitrary new Chinese lines, not just known ones
Delete one known Chinese line from cli-engine.ts, re-run extract -> manifest row count drops to 766 and the deleted row disappears; revert; WHY: script is source-driven not hardcoded
Rename cli-engine.ts temporarily, run extract -> script exits non-zero or prints a clear error mentioning the missing file; revert; WHY: script must fail gracefully when source is missing

items.title: Phase 1: translate the public CLI surface of cli-engine.ts and update affected tests
items.context: Replace Chinese with the approved English for command descriptions, Zod .describe() values, printHelp labels/examples, validation error text, unknown-command suggestions, and story/worktree next-step hints. Do NOT touch M668/M669/M750. Update any test that asserts the old Chinese output. Preserve command names, enum values, JSON keys, identifiers, and the -> Next: hint style from the plan.

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run build -> exits 0; WHY: translated source compiles without TypeScript errors
node bin/koala.js validate -> exits 0 with no failures; WHY: full validation suite passes after translation
node bin/lattice.js help 2>&1 | grep -cP [\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}] -> 0; WHY: top-level help output contains no Chinese
For each command name from lattice help, run node bin/lattice.js <cmd> --help 2>&1 | grep -cP CJK -> 0 for all commands; WHY: per-command help is fully English

grep -nP [\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}] packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts | grep -v // | grep -v M668 | grep -v M669 | grep -v M750 -> only comment lines and the 3 deferred rows remain; no .describe() / description / printHelp / error / hint lines contain Chinese; WHY: public surface is fully translated
Run the existing test suite (npm --prefix packages/main run test:cli-engine-branding-smoke or equivalent) -> all tests pass; WHY: tests asserting old Chinese output have been updated

grep -rP [\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}] packages/main/src/tasks/ | grep -v legacy | grep -v compat -> tests no longer assert Chinese output except explicitly named compatibility tests; WHY: test assertions match new English output

edge.desc: Intentionally invoke an unknown command: node bin/lattice.js xyzzy_nonexistent 2>&1 -> suggestion/error message is in English, not Chinese; WHY: unknown-command suggestion path is translated
Invoke a command with invalid JSON: node bin/lattice.js story_create {bad 2>&1 -> validation error is English; WHY: Zod validation error text is translated

Count remaining CJK characters in cli-engine.ts non-comment lines: grep -P [\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}] cli-engine.ts | grep -vP ^\s*// | wc -l -> exactly 3 lines (M668 line 2303-ish, M669 line 2306-ish, M750 line 3887-ish); WHY: only the deferred behavior-sensitive rows retain Chinese in code

Verify command names, enum values, and JSON keys are unchanged: diff the list of registerTool/command name strings before and after -> identical; WHY: identifiers must not be reworded during translation
Verify Next: hint style is preserved: grep -P Next: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts -> hints use the arrow Next: format from the plan; WHY: plan requires specific hint style

adversarial.desc: After Phase 1, re-run the extract script from CHK-001 against the modified cli-engine.ts -> manifest reflects the current state (reduced Chinese count for translated lines, deferred rows still present); WHY: manifest script remains valid after source edits

Search for partial/mixed translations: grep -nP [\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}] cli-engine.ts | grep -vP ^\s*// | grep -v M668 | grep -v M669 | grep -v M750 -> 0 lines; WHY: no line has a half-Chinese half-English translation leftover
Verify M668/M669/M750 lines are byte-identical to their pre-Phase-1 content (git diff of those specific lines shows no change); WHY: deferred rows must NOT be touched, even accidentally

Run node bin/lattice.js story_create with a Chinese-character title (e.g. title=测试) -> command succeeds and stores the Chinese title without error; WHY: translation of CLI surface must not break user-supplied Chinese data

items.title: Phase 2: translate internal comments in cli-engine.ts
items.context: After the public surface is stable, translate the remaining Chinese comments in cli-engine.ts, preserving technical meaning. Do not rewrite logic while translating comments.

happy.desc: grep -cP [\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}] packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts -> exactly 3 (only M668/M669/M750 lines); WHY: all Chinese comments have been translated, leaving only the 3 deferred runtime matchers
grep -nP ^\s*//.*[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}] packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts -> 0 lines; WHY: no Chinese remains in any comment line
npm --prefix packages/main run build -> exits 0; WHY: comment translation introduced no syntax errors
node bin/koala.js validate -> exits 0; WHY: validation still passes after comment-only changes

edge.desc: git diff packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts (Phase 2 vs Phase 1) shows only comment-line changes: every changed line starts with // or is inside a /* */ block; WHY: no logic was altered during comment translation

Verify technical terms in translated comments preserve meaning: spot-check at least 5 translated comments against the T-table entries (T001-T004, T057) for semantic accuracy; WHY: translation must preserve technical meaning per the plan
git diff --stat for Phase 2 shows only cli-engine.ts modified, no other files; WHY: comment translation is scoped to a single file

adversarial.desc: Run a full text search for common Chinese comment markers (TODO/FIXME/HACK in Chinese: 待办/修复/临时) across cli-engine.ts -> 0 hits; WHY: even informal Chinese dev annotations must be translated

Verify no Chinese was introduced into string literals during comment editing: diff the non-comment lines between Phase 1 end and Phase 2 end -> zero non-comment changes; WHY: guards against accidental code changes while editing nearby comments

items.title: Phase 3: add a no-new-Chinese gate smoke test
items.context: Add english-open-source-surface-smoke that fails when new Chinese appears in active source and active docs, with explicit allowlists for: this review document, generated translation manifests, legacy/archive docs, and migration-compatibility tests that still assert old output. Wire it into the verify/test surface.

happy.desc: File packages/main/src/tasks/english-open-source-surface-smoke.ts exists and compiles: npm --prefix packages/main run build -> exits 0; WHY: gate test file was created and is valid TypeScript
Run the smoke test in its normal (clean) state -> passes (exit 0); WHY: after Phases 1-3 the active source and docs should be Chinese-free except allowlisted paths
Verify the smoke test is wired into the test/verify surface: grep -r english-open-source-surface-smoke in package.json or test config -> referenced; WHY: gate must actually run in CI/validate

edge.desc: Confirm allowlist includes the plan doc (cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md): the smoke test does not flag Chinese in that file -> passes; WHY: the plan doc contains Chinese source snippets by design
Confirm allowlist includes generated manifest files (cli-engine-english-translation-manifest.md): smoke test ignores them -> passes; WHY: manifests contain chineseSource column
Confirm allowlist includes legacy/archive docs: place a Chinese-bearing file under an archive path -> smoke test ignores it -> passes; WHY: historical Chinese is archived not deleted
Confirm allowlist includes migration-compatibility test files that assert old Chinese output -> smoke test ignores them -> passes; WHY: compat tests may legitimately contain Chinese assertions

Verify the smoke test scans both active source (packages/) and active docs (README.md, docs/guide.md, docs/guide-hooks.md, docs/requirements/decisions/) -> these paths are all covered; WHY: gate must cover the full active surface

adversarial.desc: Plant a single Chinese character (e.g. append // 测试 to a clean active source file like packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts line 1), run the smoke test -> FAILS with a clear error message identifying the file and line; revert the planted char; WHY: gate must detect and reject even a single new Chinese character
Plant Chinese text in an active doc (e.g. append 测试 to README.md), run smoke test -> FAILS naming README.md; revert; WHY: gate covers docs not just source
Plant Chinese in an allowlisted file (e.g. the plan doc), run smoke test -> still PASSES; WHY: allowlist must actually suppress false positives

Create a new file outside allowlisted paths with Chinese content (e.g. packages/main/src/new-file-test.ts containing 中文), run smoke test -> FAILS; remove the file; WHY: gate is not limited to known files, it scans all active paths

Verify the 3 deferred M668/M669/M750 lines in cli-engine.ts do not cause the gate to fail -> passes; WHY: the allowlist or line-level exception must handle the known deferred rows without breaking the gate

items.title: Phase 4: translate related active docs and archive historical Chinese
items.context: Translate active docs that explain current behavior (README.md, docs/guide.md, docs/guide-hooks.md, and active files under docs/requirements/decisions/). Move historical Chinese-only material to explicit legacy/archive locations instead of mixing it into active open-source docs. Scope: active docs only; the plan doc itself and generated manifests are allowlisted, not retranslated.
